description.en: Frosted glass panels on a dark background, soft light and a clean interface language.
description.tr: Koyu zeminde buzlu cam paneller, yumuşak ışık ve sade bir arayüz dili.

colorRules.accent: the active element: highlighted bar, active tile, connecting line, toggle
colorRules.glowBlobs: only behind glass, always heavily blurred, never as a hard shape

display.use: big numbers and headlines, thin and elegant

fonts.mono: to be chosen with the code technique in M1

glowBlobs.drift: slow seeded drift, never faster than 20 px per second

enter.type: glass panels rise 24px and come into focus (blur 12px to 0)

motion.activate: an element turns active: border and glow fade to mint, scale 1.0 to 1.04
motion.cursor: optional UI cursor moves on smooth bezier paths and clicks with a small ripple
motion.transition: camera pushes into a glass panel until it fills the frame and becomes the next scene
